tools.name: search_osnova
tools.description: Search Основа, checked facts about Bulgarian public services (institutions, offices, contacts, procedures, fees, where to report a problem), for Plovdiv, Sofia, Varna and Burgas. Query in Bulgarian works best. Every fact has its official source and the date it was checked; cite them.

tools.name: get_osnova_entry
tools.description: One Основа entry by its id (city/kind/slug), with all its facts, sources and check dates.

tools.name: about_osnova
tools.description: What Основа covers: cities, counts, licence (CC BY 4.0), how to cite it and when it was last checked.

tools.name: srok_deadline
tools.description: Count a Bulgarian legal deadline the way the Civil Procedure Code does (ГПК чл. 60): days count from the day after the event; weeks, months and years end on the corresponding date; an end on a non-working day moves to the next working day. tools.name: srok_day
tools.description: Whether a date is a working day in Bulgaria, and if not, why (official holiday, the day after a weekend holiday, a government decision, or a weekend).

tools.name: srok_year
tools.description: Every non-working weekday and every working Saturday in a year in Bulgaria (2020–2099), with the legal basis.

tools.name: search_izvor
tools.description: Search Извор, an index of Bulgarian primary official sources (e.g. the State Gazette, municipal council decisions, public procurement notices). Returns the official record's title, issuer, number, date and official URL. Cite the official URL, not Извор; the excerpt is for orientation only.

tools.name: get_izvor_document
tools.description: One Извор record by id, with its full stored excerpt and when Nishka first and last saw it.

tools.name: about_izvor
tools.description: Which sources Извор covers, how many records each has, and when each was last collected.

tools.name: plovdiv_place_record
tools.description: What is known now about one Plovdiv street or quarter: planned water interruptions, road works and traffic changes, municipal notices, city council decisions naming it, the paid parking zone of a street, everyday places nearby, and notices no longer published — each with its source URL and dates. tools.name: plovdiv_changes
tools.description: Item-level changes Nishka saw in Plovdiv's official sources since a date — municipal notices, road works, ВиК water interruptions and Основа facts — newest first, with the source URL of each. Use it to keep an agent's own data current.
